تنتصبين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَصِبِينَ (tantaṣibīna) /tan.ta.sˤi.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# تُنْتَصَبِينَ (tuntaṣabīna) /tun.ta.sˤa.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
